scope: Read-only consolidation of the Priority 0, P1, P2 and P3 audits at one immutable baseline. No model fitting, no coordinate recomputation, no experiment, no tracked-file change.

claim_coverage.note: Unit counts are audit units, not independent scientific findings; headings, references, table cells and whole-row conjunctions each count.
